parts.title: Part 1 · Giới thiệu và phỏng vấn
parts.instruction: Giám khảo hỏi về bản thân bạn. Trả lời mỗi câu khoảng 20-30 giây, có lý do hoặc ví dụ ngắn.
questions: Where is your hometown?
What do you like most about the place where you grew up?
Has your hometown changed much in the last few years?
Would you like to live there in the future?
How do you usually get around your town or city?
Do you prefer travelling by car or by public transport? Why?
Have you ever travelled to another country?
What kind of places do you enjoy visiting on holiday?
Do you prefer short trips or long holidays?

parts.title: Part 2 · Cue card
parts.instruction: Bạn có 1 phút chuẩn bị và nói trong 1-2 phút. Hãy bám theo cả bốn gạch đầu dòng.

cueCard.topic: Describe a journey that did not go as planned.
bullets: where you were going
who you were with
what went wrong
and explain how you felt about it

parts.title: Part 3 · Thảo luận
parts.instruction: Câu hỏi trừu tượng hơn, liên quan tới chủ đề Part 2. Trả lời 40-60 giây mỗi câu và đưa ra lập luận.
questions: Why do you think people enjoy travelling to places they have never been to?
How has the way people travel changed compared with thirty years ago?
Does tourism always benefit local communities?
Some people say that travel broadens the mind. Would you agree?
What problems can large numbers of tourists cause in popular destinations?
Do you think people will travel more or less in the future?

parts.title: Part 1 · Giới thiệu và phỏng vấn
parts.instruction: Giám khảo hỏi về thói quen ăn uống và sức khoẻ của bạn. Trả lời mỗi câu khoảng 20-30 giây.
questions: What kind of food do you usually eat during the week?
Do you prefer eating at home or in restaurants?
Can you cook? Who taught you?
What would you say is a typical meal in your country?
Have your eating habits changed since you were a child?
Do you play any sport or do any kind of exercise?
How often do you exercise in a normal week?
Do you think you have a healthy lifestyle?
How many hours do you usually sleep at night?

parts.title: Part 2 · Cue card
parts.instruction: Bạn có 1 phút chuẩn bị và nói trong 1-2 phút. Ghi nhanh từ khoá cho từng ý trước khi nói.

cueCard.topic: Describe a meal you really enjoyed with other people.
bullets: what the meal was
where you ate it
who you were with
and explain why you enjoyed it so much

parts.title: Part 3 · Thảo luận
parts.instruction: Câu hỏi trừu tượng hơn, liên quan tới chủ đề Part 2. Trả lời 40-60 giây mỗi câu.
questions: Why do families in many countries eat together less often than they used to?
How important is food in the culture of your country?
Has fast food changed the way people eat?
Should governments do more to encourage people to eat healthily?
Is it better for children to learn to cook at home or at school?
How do you think the food people eat will change in the next twenty years?

parts.title: Part 1 · Giới thiệu và phỏng vấn
parts.instruction: Giám khảo hỏi về công việc, việc học và thói quen hằng ngày. Trả lời mỗi câu khoảng 20-30 giây.
questions: Do you work, or are you a student?
What subject are you studying, or what does your job involve?
Why did you choose that subject or that kind of work?
What is the most interesting part of your work or your studies?
Do you prefer working in the morning or in the evening?
Could you describe a typical day for you?
Do you usually work and study with other people or on your own?
Is there a skill you would like to learn in the next few years?
Do you think you will still be doing the same thing in ten years?

parts.title: Part 2 · Cue card
parts.instruction: Bạn có 1 phút chuẩn bị và nói trong 1-2 phút. Kể một câu chuyện cụ thể thay vì nói chung chung.

cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you had to learn something new very quickly.
bullets: what you had to learn
why you had so little time
how you managed to learn it
and explain what the experience taught you

parts.title: Part 3 · Thảo luận
parts.instruction: Câu hỏi trừu tượng hơn, liên quan tới chủ đề Part 2. Trả lời 40-60 giây mỗi câu, có ví dụ minh hoạ.
questions: Why do some adults find it harder to learn new skills than children do?
How important is it for employees to keep learning throughout their careers?
Do universities prepare young people well for the world of work?
What role should employers play in training their staff?
How has technology changed the way people learn new skills?
Are practical skills becoming more valuable than academic qualifications?

parts.title: Part 1 · Giới thiệu và phỏng vấn
parts.instruction: Giám khảo hỏi về cách bạn dùng công nghệ và giữ liên lạc. Trả lời mỗi câu khoảng 20-30 giây.
questions: How often do you use your mobile phone?
What do you use it for most of the time?
Do you prefer sending messages or making phone calls?
How do you keep in touch with friends who live far away?
Do you use social media much these days?
Can you remember a time when you did not have a smartphone?
Do you think you spend too much time online?
Do older people in your family find technology easy to use?
Is there a new piece of technology you would like to own?

parts.title: Part 2 · Cue card
parts.instruction: Bạn có 1 phút chuẩn bị và nói trong 1-2 phút. Dành nhiều thời gian nhất cho ý cuối cùng.

cueCard.topic: Describe a piece of technology that has changed the way you live or work.
bullets: what the technology is
when you started using it
how often you use it
and explain how it has changed your daily life

parts.title: Part 3 · Thảo luận
parts.instruction: Câu hỏi trừu tượng hơn, liên quan tới chủ đề Part 2. Trả lời 40-60 giây mỗi câu.
questions: Has technology made communication between people better or worse?
Why do some people feel anxious when they are separated from their phones?
Should there be limits on how much time children spend in front of screens?
How might artificial intelligence change the way we communicate every day?
Are older generations being left behind by new technology?
What are the risks of relying too heavily on digital devices?

parts.title: Part 1 · Giới thiệu và phỏng vấn
parts.instruction: Giám khảo hỏi về phim ảnh, âm nhạc và tin tức. Trả lời mỗi câu khoảng 20-30 giây.
questions: What kind of films or television programmes do you enjoy?
Do you prefer watching films at home or at the cinema?
How often do you listen to music?
Has your taste in music changed over the years?
Do you ever read newspapers or news websites?
How do you usually find out what is happening in the world?
Do you trust the news you read online?
Do you ever watch programmes in English?
Would you like to work in the media industry?
What do you usually do to relax at the weekend?

parts.title: Part 2 · Cue card
parts.instruction: Bạn có 1 phút chuẩn bị và nói trong 1-2 phút. Ở mức band cao, hãy thêm chi tiết và cảm xúc cụ thể.

cueCard.topic: Describe a film, series or programme that made a strong impression on you.
bullets: what it was about
when and where you watched it
who you watched it with or recommended it to
and explain why it made such a strong impression on you

parts.title: Part 3 · Thảo luận
parts.instruction: Câu hỏi trừu tượng và mang tính tranh luận. Trả lời 40-60 giây mỗi câu, nêu quan điểm rõ ràng.
questions: Why do you think stories and films have such a powerful effect on people?
To what extent do films and television shape the values of young people?
Is it the responsibility of the media to educate as well as to entertain?
How has streaming changed the way people watch films and series?
Do you think traditional cinemas and television channels will survive?
Should governments regulate the content that streaming platforms produce?

parts.title: Part 1 · Giới thiệu và phỏng vấn
parts.instruction: Giám khảo hỏi về nơi bạn sống và môi trường xung quanh. Trả lời mỗi câu khoảng 20-30 giây.
questions: Do you live in a city or in the countryside?
What do you like about living there?
Are there many parks or green spaces near your home?
How often do you spend time outdoors?
Is air pollution a problem where you live?
Do you and your family recycle at home?
Which environmental problems are talked about most in your country?
Have you ever taken part in an environmental activity or campaign?
Would you prefer to live somewhere quieter in the future?

parts.title: Part 2 · Cue card
parts.instruction: Bạn có 1 phút chuẩn bị và nói trong 1-2 phút. Hãy dùng ví dụ cụ thể về khu vực bạn sống.

cueCard.topic: Describe a change that would improve the area where you live.
bullets: what the change would be
why the area needs it
who would benefit from it
and explain how it would affect daily life there

parts.title: Part 3 · Thảo luận
parts.instruction: Câu hỏi trừu tượng và mang tính tranh luận. Trả lời 40-60 giây mỗi câu, cân nhắc cả hai phía.
questions: Who should be most responsible for solving environmental problems: individuals, companies or governments?
Why do many people find it so difficult to change their environmental habits?
How can cities be designed so that they are more pleasant places to live?
Can economic growth and environmental protection really go together?
What role should international agreements play in tackling climate change?
How do you imagine cities will look fifty years from now?

title: Speaking Test: Daily Routines and Productivity

parts.title: Introduction and General Questions
parts.instruction: Answer the following questions about your daily habits and how you manage your time.
questions: What does your typical morning routine look like?
Do you prefer to wake up early or stay up late? Why?
How do you usually plan your daily schedule?
Is there anything you would like to change about your daily routine?
How do you feel when your routine is suddenly disrupted?
Do you think having a strict routine is important for everyone?
What part of the day do you feel most productive?
How do you usually unwind after a busy day?

parts.title: Individual Long Turn
parts.instruction: Describe a productive day you once had. You will have 1 minute to prepare and up to 2 minutes to speak.

cueCard.topic: Describe a productive day you once had
bullets: When this day happened
What you did on that day
Why you needed to be productive
and explain how you felt at the end of the day.

parts.title: Two-way Discussion
parts.instruction: Discuss the following abstract questions related to productivity, time management, and modern lifestyles.
questions: Why do some people find it difficult to maintain a consistent daily routine?
In what ways has modern technology affected our ability to stay productive?
Do you think working from home makes people more or less productive compared to working in an office?
How important is it for companies to encourage work-life balance for their employees?
Do you agree that people nowadays are obsessed with constant productivity?

title: Speaking Test: A Useful Piece of Technology

parts.title: Introduction and Interview
parts.instruction: Answer the examiner's questions about your daily routine and technology habits.
questions: What type of electronic device do you use the most every day?
How often do you buy new gadgets or technology products?
Is there any piece of technology that you find difficult to use?
What technology did you use when you were a child?
Do you think children nowadays spend too much time using electronic devices?
How has technology changed the way people communicate with each other?
Do you prefer reading digital books on a screen or traditional printed books?
Are there any new technological inventions that you are looking forward to trying?

parts.title: Individual Long Turn
parts.instruction: Describe a useful piece of technology that you rely on regularly. You have one minute to prepare and up to two minutes to speak.

cueCard.topic: Describe a useful piece of technology that you rely on regularly.
bullets: what this device is
how long you have had it
what you typically use it for
and explain why it is so useful to you in your daily life

parts.title: Two-way Discussion
parts.instruction: Discuss more abstract questions related to technology, human relationships, and the future.
questions: In what ways has modern technology changed the traditional workplace environment?
Do you agree that technological advancements make people more isolated rather than more connected?
How might artificial intelligence influence traditional educational systems in the next few decades?
Should governments place stricter regulations on how tech companies collect and use personal data?
Do you think older generations face significant barriers when trying to adapt to modern technology?

title: Speaking Test: Public spaces and community life

parts.title: Introduction and Interview
parts.instruction: Answer the following questions about yourself and your local environment.
questions: What kinds of public spaces are most popular in your hometown?
Do you prefer visiting parks or indoor shopping malls in your free time?
How often do you visit public parks or green spaces?
What do you usually do when you spend time in a park?
Did you visit public spaces a lot when you were a child?
How have the public spaces in your city changed over the last ten years?
Do you think there are enough public spaces in your local area?
What facilities would you like to see added to public spaces in your neighborhood?

parts.title: Long Turn
parts.instruction: Describe a public park or garden in your city that you enjoy visiting. You have one minute to prepare and up to two minutes to speak.

cueCard.topic: Describe a public park or garden in your city that you enjoy visiting
bullets: where it is located
what it looks like and what facilities it has
how often you go there and who you go with
and explain why this park is important to you and your community.

parts.title: Discussion
parts.instruction: Discuss the following deeper questions related to public spaces and community development.
questions: How do public spaces contribute to the overall well-being of city residents?
To what extent is the design of public spaces important for fostering a sense of community?
Should governments prioritize funding for public parks over commercial infrastructure? Why?
How has modern technology changed the way people interact when they are in public spaces?
What challenges do urban planners face when trying to create green spaces in densely populated cities?
Do you think private spaces, such as shopping malls, will eventually replace traditional public squares?

title: IELTS Speaking Test - Learning from Failure

parts.title: Introduction and Interview
parts.instruction: Answer the following questions about your daily life and experiences with mistakes.
questions: Do you easily learn from your mistakes, or do you tend to repeat them?
How do you usually feel when something you planned does not work out?
Did your teachers or parents encourage you to make mistakes when you were a child?
Do you think children nowadays are afraid of making mistakes at school?
What was the last minor mistake you made recently?
Do you prefer to plan everything carefully to avoid failure, or just see what happens?
Is it important for people to talk about their failures publicly?
Do you think social media makes people hide their failures?

parts.title: Individual Long Turn
parts.instruction: Describe a time when you failed at something important. You have 1 minute to prepare and up to 2 minutes to speak.

cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you failed at something important.
bullets: What the situation was
Why you failed
How you reacted to this failure
and explain what you learned from this experience.

parts.title: Two-way Discussion
parts.instruction: Discuss the following abstract questions related to failure and success.
questions: Why do many people view failure as a negative reflection of their character rather than a learning opportunity?
How can educational systems better prepare students to handle setbacks and disappointments?
Do you agree that modern society puts too much emphasis on continuous success?
In what ways can a major corporate failure actually benefit an entire industry in the long run?
How does cultural background influence the way people perceive and react to personal failure?
